decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's established reissue and catalog business, costs little to keep listed in a warehouse-backed online shop, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search toward dropping it.

The illustrated release series builds on the label's core curation strength and its strategy of broadening formats, and growing industry turnover gives enough slack to carry an edition series whose returns may take time to show.
